verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers Snowflake's warehouses, Time Travel, RBAC, Secure Data Sharing, and CLI/dbt tooling, but nowhere describes an explicit sandbox/dev-test environment feature (e.g., zero-copy cloning of production data into an isolated schema) that lets a user test against a copy without touching production. No citation ties any feature to isolating an AI/agent's test workflow from production data.
